vega-toroid.name: Vega Toroid
vega-toroid.description:
A device of undetermined function and origin. Prized by Vox Solaris and the Quills.

Earn Vega Toroids from enemies located at the Spaceport in the Orb Vallis and from Mite Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).

venerdo-alloy.name: Venerdo Alloy
venerdo-alloy.description:
A compound formed from Venerol.

Blueprint sold by Smokefinger in Fortuna on Venus.

venerol.name: Venerol
venerol.description:
A precious metal forged from coolant byproducts.

Location: Orb Vallis (Venus) from Red Mining Veins and Resource Containers

veridos.name: Veridos
veridos.description:
A highly reflective, green gem.

Location: Plains of Eidolon (Earth) from Blue Mining Veins and Thumpers

vessel-capillaries.name: Vessel Capillaries
vessel-capillaries.description:
A crucial sub-component in the construction of Albrecht Entrati's vessels.

Obtained from Disruption missions on Armatus, Deimos.

vestan-moss.name: Vestan Moss
vestan-moss.description:
One of the few known plant species able to thrive on asteroids in deep space. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Vestan Moss plants that grow on Mercury, Saturn, and Sedna

vestigial-motes.name: Vestigial Motes
vestigial-motes.description:
Remnants of Jade's light. Echoes of her power.

Obtained from Ascension missions on Brutus, Uranus.

voidgel-orb.name: Voidgel Orb
voidgel-orb.description:
A sample of ambient Void energy distilled into a neutral state.

Location: Zariman

voidplume-crest.name: Voidplume Crest
voidplume-crest.description:
The fine plumes from a Void Angel's crown.

Location: Zariman

voidplume-down.name: Voidplume Down
voidplume-down.description:
Barbed and half-real, shed by a Void Angel.

Location: Zariman

voidplume-pinion.name: Voidplume Pinion
voidplume-pinion.description:
A Void Angel's living feather, ripped out in combat.

Location: Zariman

voidplume-quill.name: Voidplume Quill
voidplume-quill.description:
A symbol of genius, fallen from Void Angels long ago.

Location: Zariman

voidplume-vane.name: Voidplume Vane
voidplume-vane.description:
A metallic plume from a Void Angel's wing.

Location: Zariman

voidrig-capsule.name: Voidrig Capsule
voidrig-capsule.description: Capsule component for the Voidrig Necramech.

voidrig-casing.name: Voidrig Casing
voidrig-casing.description: Casing component for the Voidrig Necramech.

voidrig-engine.name: Voidrig Engine
voidrig-engine.description: Engine component for the Voidrig Necramech.

voidrig-weapon-pod.name: Voidrig Weapon Pod
voidrig-weapon-pod.description: Weapon Pod component for the Voidrig Necramech.

volatile-motes.name: Volatile Motes
volatile-motes.description:
Highly charged particles of pure energy. The source of the Jade Light, and Jade's power. Highly coveted by Parvos Granum for his Jade Eximus program.

Obtained from Operation Ascension missions (Brutus on Uranus) and special Operation Alerts during Operation: Belly of the Beast.
